title: Audit #6030's deferred layer and current BIT stock
body:
Answers the scoped audit question in #6110 by specializing the retained support-local transfer proofs to the selected construction in #6030. **No new κ or selected-record change.**

## Result

- **Correct recurrence:** use the compiled uniform supplier, rather than the raw mixed P104 histogram.
- **Exact moment bounds:**
  $$
  \mu_{1-b}<2^{-47005},
  \qquad
  \mu_{1-a}<2^{-94010}.
  $$
- **Current BIT stock:** use atom $1/250$, replacing the historical $0.003$ in this specialization. An explicit symbolic stock threshold has logarithmic degree $250/83$.
- **Complete conditional cost argument:** weighted-tree and separately derived induction proofs cover integer floors, remainders, stopped leaves, deferred phases and per-phase padding deletion.

The generic deferral method is already present in #1673 and the selected finite-template/outer-transfer sources. This audit credits those proofs and supplies the current parameter substitution; it does not claim a new deferral method.

[Research package](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/tree/643891684cf7890e22f4256ae22ae441040d10cd/research/p104-6030-deferred-layer) · [Proof](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/643891684cf7890e22f4256ae22ae441040d10cd/research/p104-6030-deferred-layer/PROOF.md) · [Canonical Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19239759)

## Verification

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-6030-deferred-layer
```

All four normal/optimized checks pass on CPython 3.12.14:

| Check | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Primary verifier | 48 threshold fixtures, 528 padding fixtures, 12 rejection controls |
| Independent verifier | 4,152 recursion widths, 255 deferred schedules, 3 parameter rejection controls |
| Publication checks | Committed bytes, source history, 26-file export and integrity |
| Portable replay | Both verifiers pass normally and optimized in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all bytes remain unchanged |

Two separate Codex agents independently derived or reviewed the result. No unresolved blocking issue remained. See [validation and logs](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/643891684cf7890e22f4256ae22ae441040d10cd/research/p104-6030-deferred-layer/VALIDATION.md) and [internal review](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/643891684cf7890e22f4256ae22ae441040d10cd/research/p104-6030-deferred-layer/REVIEW.md). These are local results; hosted CI is separate.

## Scope and next step

The compiler bill, physical node costs, complete-field interface, BIT stock law and exact return/padding deletion remain premises. The stock threshold depends on unmaterialized fixed constants. All five framework assumptions remain; no full selected replay, materialized rounded multiplier, human review or proof-kernel certification is claimed.

The next useful task is to audit an actual emitted child/row boundary against those physical contracts. A future maintainer review can also cite the already-selected transfer sources explicitly.
